maria_cs: Quick weekly Harbor account health check — p95/p99 latency by route & model, streaming vs non-streaming. Observations below. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
ankur_se: dropping the raw numbers please
maria_cs: ```
Route | Model | Mode | p95 (ms) | p99 (ms)
chat | rw-7b-v1 | streaming | 210 | 480
chat | rw-7b-v1 | non-streaming | 320 | 920
completion | rw-13b-q4 | streaming | 340 | 760
completion | rw-13b-q4 | non-streaming | 610 | 1500
embeddings | mistral-small | non-streaming | 90 | 250
embeddings | mistral-small | streaming | 85 | 240
``` 
maria_cs: Notes: 1) rw-13b non-streaming p99 jump tied to cold starts on dedicated nodes, 2) streaming helps reduce tail for chat models but increases p95 variability for long sequences
ella_infra: saw related spike in node-restarts earlier today — filing infra ticket. cpu/gpu logs point to memory fragmentation
cj_customer: Thanks — we're seeing some user complaints about lag on long chat sessions. Any mitigation now? :thinking_face:
ankur_se: short-term: enable client-side streaming (falls back) and increase prefix cache for Harbor; mid-term: bump dedicated pool to newer instance family
maria_cs: action: ops to apply prefix cache change today (assigned @ella_infra), infra to root-cause mem fragmentation (assigned @ankur_se). I'll ping Harbor PM with expected improvements by EOD
ops_bot: Incident created #INC-4821 for memory fragmentation, CC: @ella_infra @ankur_se
maria_cs: any objections to running a canary with rw-13b-q4 streaming only for Harbor tomorrow morning? :eyes:
ella_infra: no objections, will schedule 1-hr canary 10:00 UTC
maria_cs: thanks — I'll update Harbor and track p95/p99 post-canary. Closing this thread unless new data.
